loopkeeper.welcome.intro.title: LoopKeeper — close the loop you keep meaning to close
loopkeeper.welcome.intro.copy: उस एक काम से शुरू करें जिसे आप लगातार टाल रहे हैं — एक इंसान जिस तक पहुँचना है, एक फ़ैसला जो लेना है, एक नवीनीकरण जो भेजना है। लय़ बनाइए। लूप बंद कीजिए।
loopkeeper.welcome.intro.surprise: Stay to the end — we’ll close one real loop together.
loopkeeper.welcome.card.title: The card is everything
loopkeeper.welcome.card.copy: जिस हर व्यक्ति तक पहुँचना चाहते हैं, और हर काम जिसे टालते रहते हैं, वह एक कार्ड है - कोई काम, जगह, कार्यक्रम: जो भी आप पूरा करना चाहते हैं वह कार्ड बन सकता है। उसे टैप करें: उस व्यक्ति या काम की हर बात वहीं रहती है। जो सबसे ज़रूरी है उसी से शुरू करें; जैसे-जैसे पूरा करें, आगे जोड़ें।
loopkeeper.welcome.loopmotto.title: No more “I keep meaning to”
loopkeeper.welcome.loopmotto.copy: हर छूटा जवाब एक ही तरह शुरू होता है: "जवाब देना था।" LoopKeeper वह ख़याल ठंडा होने से पहले पकड़ लेता है - गहरा संदर्भ पढ़ता है, जिससे आपका जवाब बाकी है वह व्यक्ति या काम सामने लाता है, और लम्हा अभी गर्म है तो शब्द दे देता है। आग बुझने से पहले लूप पूरा हो जाता है।
loopkeeper.welcome.fourws.title: The deep context
loopkeeper.welcome.fourws.copy: कौन, क्या, कहाँ, कब - हर कार्ड, व्यक्ति या काम के पीछे की कहानी। बेहतरीन सचिव यह हमेशा जानते थे: रिश्तों, सौदों और टाले गए इरादों की पृष्ठभूमि जानना ही हर फ़ॉलो-अप, संकेत और ड्राफ़्ट को सटीक बनाता है।
loopkeeper.welcome.followup.title: The follow-up engine
loopkeeper.welcome.followup.copy: It reads the deep context and schedules the check-ins you keep meaning to make, surfacing who you owe a reply — the small loops caught before they go cold.
loopkeeper.welcome.followup.emphasis: You no longer forget. You no longer delay. You no longer postpone.
loopkeeper.welcome.confidante.title: The AI drafts — you hit Send
loopkeeper.welcome.confidante.copy: प्रारूप इसी फ़ोन पर लिखा जाता है। गर्मजोशी भरा संस्करण तभी जाता है जब आप फिर से आज़माएँ दबाएँ।

loopkeeper.aboutTxt.tagline: The end of 'I keep meaning to.'
loopkeeper.aboutTxt.privacy1: आप और काम के बीच कोई साइन-अप नहीं। जो कुछ भी आप जोड़ते हैं, वह स्वैच्छिक है और इसी फ़ोन पर रहता है, जब तक आप क्लाउड या सर्वर चालू न करें।
loopkeeper.aboutTxt.privacy2: भेजने पर आपका अपना WhatsApp या फ़ोन ऐप खुलता है — Send आप दबाते हैं। LoopKeeper Zyppar का बना है — https://zyppar.com/loopkeeper/ बुकमार्क करें।
loopkeeper.aboutTxt.what: LoopKeeper पुरानी टालमटोल के लिए बनी ऐप है — न आदत ट्रैकर, न टू-डू सूची: उनके लिए इंजन जो जानते हैं क्या करना है और कर नहीं पाते। LoopKeeper is a relationship follow-through assistant — the antidote to 'I keep meaning to.' Choose one person who matters and set a rhythm — lunch every month, a call now and then — and when the moment comes, LoopKeeper nudges you, helps you close the loop, and lights the streak so the care becomes something you can see. One person at a time, never the whole address book: one small, finished win, then the next. The idea at its heart is older than any app — wind the wheel back to 1958.
loopkeeper.aboutTxt.hist1: Young'uns today may not know how crucial it was that a treasured secretary kept the records — connections, relationships, dates, appointments — for the best executives. Nothing forgotten, everything moving smoothly, always.
loopkeeper.aboutTxt.hist2: Before software, the remembering lived on a desk. The Rolodex — Arnold Neustadter's rolling index, patented 1956 and on desks everywhere by 1958 — sat beside the telephone of every capable secretary. One card per person: a name, a number, a penciled note — prefers mornings, ask about the daughter. Flip the wheel, find the face, make the call. The card carried the details so the person at the desk could carry the relationship.
loopkeeper.aboutTxt.hist3: What came next were plastic pocket folders with card slots — the Rolodex name survived across countless iterations. At first they lived on the secretary's desk, the quiet center of the executive suite. Then they became smaller and handier, and every businessperson kept one or several of their own — or synced theirs with an assistant's.
loopkeeper.aboutTxt.hist4: LoopKeeper is that idea, still working: one card per person, holding their story. What's new is that the card answers back — after every send, the Assistant writes what happened onto it, so the next nudge arrives already knowing. A Rolodex that writes back. You supply the caring; the card does the remembering.
loopkeeper.aboutTxt.timelineTitle: From the desk to the loop — five eras of keeping track
loopkeeper.aboutTxt.era1: Every desk kept its own little archive.
loopkeeper.aboutTxt.era2: Flip, find, call — one card per person.
loopkeeper.aboutTxt.era3: The name survived; the wheel left her desk.
loopkeeper.aboutTxt.era4: The Rolodex shrinks into a pocket organizer.
loopkeeper.aboutTxt.era5: The card writes back — the AI is the new secretary.
loopkeeper.aboutTxt.eraClose: The wheel became the loop. The card writes back. LoopKeeper is that secretary, digitized.
loopkeeper.aboutTxt.why: Nearly everyone carries the same quiet debt: the friend you keep meaning to call back, the thank-you that died in drafts, the birthday that slipped while you meant to notice. Nobody stopped caring — life got loud, and somewhere between intending and doing, the fire went cold. An unfinished thing nags at the mind until it's done; psychology has known that since Zeigarnik, 1927. LoopKeeper exists to finish the small ones before they cost anything: a rhythm set once, a nudge when it's due, a message ready the minute you finally have two free minutes. The resolve it offers is simple — the people you mean to keep will hear from you while it still counts.
loopkeeper.aboutTxt.pillSub: Ten kinds of people who lose real money or real affection to unclosed loops
loopkeeper.aboutTxt.cohortsIntro: Each of these loses something every week they leave loops open — an invoice, a vote of trust, a place in someone's memory. Find yourself, and LoopKeeper was tuned for your week. Find someone you love, and it's one send away.
loopkeeper.aboutTxt.c1: Freelancers & consultants — the pipeline is relationships; a forgotten follow-up is a lost invoice
loopkeeper.aboutTxt.c2: Small-business founders & solopreneurs — leads, suppliers and mentors gone quiet
loopkeeper.aboutTxt.c3: Sales & business-development people — "let's circle back next quarter" is an open loop by definition
loopkeeper.aboutTxt.c4: Recruiters & career coaches — candidates expect replies that slip
loopkeeper.aboutTxt.c5: Community & faith leaders — dozens of small promises made every week ("I'll call you this week")
loopkeeper.aboutTxt.c6: NGO & volunteer coordinators — donors and volunteers waiting on words
loopkeeper.aboutTxt.c7: Journalists & PR professionals — sources and pitches that must not go cold
loopkeeper.aboutTxt.c8: Real-estate agents — clients who vanish for months, then reappear ready to buy
loopkeeper.aboutTxt.c9: Diaspora families — cousins, parents, "we should talk" across time zones
loopkeeper.aboutTxt.c10: Coaches, mentors & event organizers — networks built on one-line promises
loopkeeper.aboutTxt.cohortsShare: See yourself here? Start with one loop you actually owe. See a friend, a sibling, a colleague in one of these ten? Hand them LoopKeeper — Settings → Share LoopKeeper.
loopkeeper.aboutTxt.plan1: LoopKeeper (Basic · $1/month): cards for the people who matter, groups, reminders, the follow-up engine, birthdays, sync, pods, in-app chat.
loopkeeper.aboutTxt.plan2: LoopKeeper (Assistant · $5/month): everything in Basic, plus the Assistant — messages composed in your own voice, spoken aloud before you send, with preset guides, suggested follow-ups and timing.

loopkeeper.add.iosTitle: iPhone अपनी पता पुस्तिका बंद रखता है
loopkeeper.add.iosBody: Apple किसी भी वेब ऐप को फ़ोन के संपर्क पढ़ने की अनुमति नहीं देता — LoopKeeper को भी नहीं, और हमें खेद है। आपके फ़ोन में कोई कमी नहीं। दो ईमानदार रास्ते: लोगों को यहाँ टाइप करें (हर एक पर सेकंड), या App Store पर LoopKeeper ऐप का इंतज़ार करें, जो उन्हें ठीक से पढ़ेगा।

loopkeeper.add.iosOnestep: LoopKeeper के iPhone वर्शन की प्रतीक्षा में, एक समय में एक व्यक्ति अच्छा काम करती है: जरूरत पड़ने पर उन्हें टाइप करें।

loopkeeper.add.vcfStep2: फ़ाइल को इस फ़ोन में सहेंं (Files या Downloads)।
loopkeeper.add.vcfStep3: नीचे इंपोर्ट के दरवाज़े को टैप करें और फ़ाइल चुनें।
loopkeeper.add.sysNote: If the phone then shows a notice that contacts "will be shared with zyppar.com" - that is the phone’s own standard wording for any site that asks to read contacts. The people you pick go only into LoopKeeper on this phone.
